subject.scene_narrative: A young woman stands calmly at a small tabletop easel, one hand steadying the canvas frame while the other draws a loaded brush through a soft grey wash — warm and cool color blooms outward from the stroke like a quiet sunrise. The image is entirely symbolic and hopeful — an abstract visual metaphor for healing and restoration, with no clinical setting, no distress, and no depiction of trauma itself. Same full-body flat vector language as the approved Q1 references.
subject.hero_prop: small canvas on a tabletop easel with a soft grey wash and a warm-to-cool abstract color bloom expanding from a single brush stroke — no recognizable imagery within the bloom
supporting_props: watercolor palette tray with three warm pigment wells
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey circles behind figure — no room interior, no walls or furniture beyond the easel
subject.sensitive_handling: This slot represents art therapy for trauma survivors, a sensitive topic. Depict only a calm, standing figure at an easel with an abstract, hopeful color bloom — no clinical setting, no medical props, no tears, no bandages, no distressed body language or facial expression, and no reference to the trauma itself. Tone must read as gentle and restorative, suitable for a general-audience career quiz.

composition.layout: figure centered slightly left, easel and canvas right at eye level, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + canvas bloom readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter S, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, hospital, clinic, medical equipment, bandages, wounds, tears, crying, self-harm, crisis imagery, weapons, blood, distressing imagery, industrial horror

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face with a small calm smile. Young college-age woman, average relaxed build, warm brown skin #B67A52, natural curly afro at shoulder length, standing calmly at a small tabletop easel. She wears a soft lavender-tinted #E8DFF5 knit cardigan with a lavender #9575CD ribbed cuff trim, dark relaxed trousers, and simple flats. One hand gently steadies the wood-frame canvas edge; the other draws an orange-loaded paintbrush through a grey #C9C9C9 wash, and warm yellow and lavender color blooms outward from the stroke like a soft sunrise — an entirely abstract, non-figurative bloom shape, no recognizable imagery. A small teal water cup and a palette tray with three warm pigment wells sit on the easel ledge. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame, NO clinical setting, NO medical props, NO tears or bandages. Mood: gentle, hopeful, quietly restorative — color emerging from grey, entirely symbolic. Full head-to-feet visible.
